title: verbascum × godronii var. lamottei
intro: Verbascum × godronii var. lamottei, commonly known as Mullein, is a biennial plant in the Scrophulariaceae family. It is known for its large, velvety leaves and tall spikes of yellow flowers, which have been used in herbal medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Mullein include its ability to soothe respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and calm digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Mullein include saponins, flavonoids, and iridoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
